an9.39:1.2: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave, saṅgāme asurā jiniṃsu devā parājiyiṃsu.
an9.39:1.3: parājitā ca bhikkhave devā apayaṃsveva uttarena mukhā abhiyaṃsu asurā.
an9.39:1.7: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave, devā asurehi saṅgāmesuṃ
an9.39:1.8: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave, asurāva jiniṃsu devā parājiyiṃsu
an9.39:1.9: parājitā ca bhikkhave devā bhītā apayaṃsveva uttarenamukhā abhiyaṃsu asurā:
an9.39:2.4: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave, devā asurehi saṅgāmesuṃ.
an9.39:2.5: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave, asurāva jiniṃsu devā parājiyiṃsu.
an9.39:2.6: parājitā ca bhikkhave, devā bhītā devapuraṃ yeva pavisiṃsu.
an9.39:2.8: “bhīruttānagatena kho dāni mayaṃ etarahi attanā viharāma. akaraṇīyā asurehī” ti.
an9.39:2.10: “bhīruttānagatena kho dāni devā etarahi attanā viharanti. akaraṇīyā ambhehī”ti.
an9.39:3.2: tasmiṃ kho pana bhikkhave, saṅgāme devā jiniṃsu. asurā parājiyisu,
an9.39:3.3: parājitā ca bhikkhave asurā apayaṃsveva dakkhiṇena mukhā, abhiyaṃsu devā.
an9.39:3.7: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave, asurā devehi saṅgāmesuṃ.
an9.39:3.8: dutiyampi kho bhikkhave, devo ca jiniṃsu. asurā parājiṃsu.
an9.39:3.9: parājitā ca bhikkhave, asurā apayaṃsve va dakkhiṇena mukhā. abhiyaṃsu devā.
an9.39:4.4: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave, asurā devehi saṅgāmesuṃ,
an9.39:4.5: tatiyampi kho bhikkhave, devā va jiniṃsu asurā parājiyiṃsu.
an9.39:4.6: parājitā va bhikkhave, asurā bhītā asurapuraññeva pavisiṃsu.
an9.39:4.7: asurapura gatānañca pana bhikkhave, asurānaṃ etadahosi:
an9.39:4.8: bhīruttānagatena kho dāni mayaṃ etarahi attanā viharāma. akaraṇīyā devehī”ti.
an9.39:4.10: “bhīruttānagatena kho dāni asurā etarahi attanā viharanti, akaraṇīyā amhehī”ti.
an9.39:5.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.39:5.2: tasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti:
an9.39:5.3: “bhīruttānagatena kho dānāhaṃ etarahi attanā viharāmi, akaraṇīyo mārassā”ti.
an9.39:5.5: “bhīruttānagatena kho dāni bhikkhu etarahi attanā viharati. akaraṇīyo mayhanti”.
an9.39:6.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā …pe… dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ …pe…
an9.39:6.4: tasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye bhikkhussa evaṃ hoti:
an9.39:6.5: “bhīruttānagatena kho dānāhaṃ etarahi attanā viharāmi, akaraṇīye mārassā”ti.
an9.39:6.7: “bhīruttānagatena kho dāni bhikkhu etarahi attanā viharati, akaraṇīyo mayhanti”
an9.39:7.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati,
an9.39:7.2: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu antamakāsi māraṃ apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato.
an9.39:8.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. …pe…
an9.39:8.2: sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.39:8.3: sabbaso ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati …pe…
an9.39:8.4: sabbaso nevasaññānāsaññāyatanaṃ samatikkamma saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ upasampajja viharati. paññāya cassa disvā āsavā parikkhīṇā honti.
an9.39:8.5: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave, bhikkhu antamakāsi māraṃ apadaṃ vadhitvā māracakkhuṃ adassanaṃ gato pāpimato, tiṇṇaṃ loke visattikanti.
